query: What signals suggest an incident resolution will be inefficient?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: Derived from short_description, known at open time; category (e.g., hardware vs software) plausibly correlates with resolution efficiency and lies outside the focus.

per_column.name: failure_type
per_column.rationale: Nature of failure (physical damage, connectivity, performance) is knowable up front and plausibly predicts how hard/long resolution will be; not a restatement of the outcome.

per_column.name: affected_device_type
per_column.rationale: Device type is available early and can carry signal about resolution complexity; independent of the efficiency outcome.

per_column.name: assignee_is_resolver
per_column.rationale: Whether the assignee ended up being the resolver reflects reassignment/hand-off behavior that unfolds during the resolution process; it is only known at/after closure and is intertwined with efficiency itself, so it leaks the outcome.

per_column.name: repeat_incident_signal
per_column.rationale: Whether the incident/caller appears to be recurring is knowable independently of this incident's outcome and plausibly predicts inefficiency; a legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: description_specificity
per_column.rationale: Specificity of the report text is available at open time and vague descriptions plausibly correlate with slower/inefficient handling; outside the focus.

per_column.name: requires_physical_action
per_column.rationale: Whether a physical intervention is needed is inferable up front and plausibly drives longer resolution paths; independent predictive signal.

per_column.name: opened_day_of_week
per_column.rationale: Temporal context known at open time; weekend/weekday effects on staffing can plausibly influence efficiency. Weak but legitimate, non-leaking predictor.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are legitimate, early-knowable predictors capturing incident nature, device, recurrence, report quality, physical-action need, and timing—collectively giving a model meaningful leverage beyond the raw fields. However several (incident_category, affected_device_type, failure_type, requires_physical_action) are correlated re-encodings of the same short_description signal, so their marginal information overlaps. assignee_is_resolver is leakage because resolver-vs-assignee status reflects hand-offs occurring during resolution and is entangled with the efficiency outcome. Net: solid but partially redundant predictive value.
